title: Cuphead + Mega Man SFR Mashup
tagline: Play as Mega Man in Cuphead's boss rush with Mega Man SFR weapons and music.
description: A Cuphead-hosted boss rush mashup featuring Mega Man Super Fighting Robot's weapons, robot masters, and music from the player's installed copy. Fight classic Cuphead bosses using Mega Man's movement and weapon mechanics, with iconic Mega Man SFR music playing during encounters.
